# UniAtlas Bosnia

UniAtlas Bosnia is a free, open-source directory of universities, faculties, study programs, and subjects in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The site provides a searchable web interface and a public REST API.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://atlasuniverziteta.com/)
- [Universities](https://atlasuniverziteta.com/universities)
- [API Docs](https://atlasuniverziteta.com/api-docs)

## API access

- [All universities endpoint](https://api.atlasuniverziteta.com/api/v1/universities)
- [University by id endpoint](https://api.atlasuniverziteta.com/api/v1/universities/1)
- [Unified search endpoint (universities, faculties, study programs, subjects)](https://api.atlasuniverziteta.com/api/v1/search?searchTerm=sarajevo)
